description: Lists downloadable BDC data files for a specific as-of date — fixed availability by state and provider, mobile coverage, and challenge data — with file metadata (provider, state, technology, record count). Download URLs are included for each file. Requires FCC BDC API credentials (FCC_BDC_USERNAME and FCC_BDC_HASH_VALUE). Use fcc_list_filing_periods first to determine valid as_of_date values (BDC dates start June 2022); a date that is not on the calendar, or that falls before the first BDC period, is rejected without credentials, while a well-formed date the BDC API does not publish is rejected once credentials let the published set be read. One as-of date can carry thousands of per-provider files, so results come back a page at a time: totalFiles counts every file matching the filters, the response reports the offset and the count on this page, and it carries a nextOffset to pass back for the following page until the last one, which omits it.

as_of_date.description: BDC as-of date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g., "2024-06-30"). Get valid dates from fcc_list_filing_periods with include_bdc=true.

category.description: File category. "State" = per-state coverage files. "Provider" = per-provider files. "Summary" = aggregate coverage tables.

data_type.description: "availability" = ISP-reported coverage files (by state and provider). "challenge" = consumer and government dispute records.

limit.description: Maximum number of files to return on one page.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first file to return, within the files matching the filters. Start at 0 and follow the nextOffset each response carries.

provider_name.description: Partial provider holding company name to filter results (case-insensitive).

state.description: Filter to one state's files (2-letter abbreviation, e.g., "WA").

technology_type.description: Filter to a specific technology type of coverage data.

name: fcc_list_downloads

category.description: Category filter applied. Absent when not filtered.

providerName.description: Provider name filter applied. Absent when not filtered.

state.description: State filter applied. Absent for all-state results.

technologyType.description: Technology type filter applied. Absent when not filtered.

count.description: Files actually returned on this page. Zero both when nothing matched and when the offset is past the end; the notice says which.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `credentials_required`: FCC_BDC_USERNAME or FCC_BDC_HASH_VALUE environment variables are not set. `invalid_as_of_date`: The as_of_date is not a date on the calendar, falls before the first BDC filing period, or is not among the as-of dates the BDC API publishes. The first two are caught without credentials; the third needs them, since only the credentialed endpoint knows the published set. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

files.description: Downloadable BDC files on this page, in the order the BDC API lists them.

downloadUrl.description: Direct download URL for the file.

fileSizeBytes.description: File size in bytes when available.

recordCount.description: Number of records in the file when available.

nextOffset.description: Offset to pass back for the next page. Omitted on the last page and when the offset is past the end.

notice.description: Where this page sits in the matching set and how to continue — or, when the page is empty, whether nothing matched the filters or the offset ran past the end.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first file on this page.

pageSize.description: Maximum files one page returns — the limit that was applied.

totalFiles.description: Files matching the filters across every page, not just this one. Compare against the count enrichment field to see how much of the set this page holds.

truncated.description: True when this page holds fewer files than totalFiles, so more pages exist.

title: List BDC Downloads
